claude.sample_unit: LLM outputs (50 synthetic urologic patient messages x 3 prompt arms)

links.outcome: Unsafe undertriage and overtriage of urologic messages across prompt arms (neutral vs safety-focused prompts)
links.effect: No unsafe undertriage in any arm. Overtriage 2/50 (4.0%) in P1, 8/50 (16.0%) in P2, 9/50 (18.0%) in P3; P2 and P3 significantly higher than P1 (p=0.031, p=0.016).
links.quote: Compared with P1, overtriage was significantly higher in P2 and P3 (p = 0.031 and p = 0.016, respectively), with no difference between P2 and P3.

links.outcome: Missed urgent conditions and omission of critical warnings in triage of patient messages
links.effect: No unsafe undertriage or omission of critical warnings occurred in any arm (150 outputs).
links.quote: No unsafe undertriage or omission of critical warnings occurred in any arm.

unlisted_practices: Prompt structure engineering (red-flag-focused and safety/triage-calibration-focused prompts) for LLM triage of patient messages
